newsitem.title: USA: Fresh America to merge with Tom Lange Co.
newsitem.headline: Fresh America to merge with Tom Lange Co.

text.p: Fresh America Corp, a major national food distribution company, entered a tentative agreement to acquire Tom Lange Co, an employee-owned produce sales and distribution company.
The combined company is expected to have pro forma annual net sales exceeding $600 million for the current fiscal year ending January 2, 1998, Fresh America said in a statement.
Under the agreement, Fresh America would issue $21 million of its common stock for Tom Lange's stock, which is held by an employee stock ownership program.
Among the assets to be acquired are cash and liquid investments of approximately $6 million, which will be used by the combined company to further its aggressive growth plans, Fresh America said.

The transaction is subject to execution of a definitive agreement, review under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act, approval by the shareholders of Fresh America and the Tom Lange ESOP trustee, and other customary closing conditions.
It would be accounted for as a pooling of interests and is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 1997.
Fresh America said it expects the transaction to be accretive for Fresh America on an earnings per share basis in the first full year of combined operations.
For its fiscal year ended January 3, 1997, Fresh America posted net sales of $239.2 million, operating income of $6.0 million and net income of $4.0 million.
